title: Jump to the error line
brief: A build log has an error. Set mark 'e' on the ERROR line, jump back to the top, then return to the mark and delete that line.
text:
Build started...
Compiling module A
Compiling module B
ERROR: missing semicolon in main.c
Build finished with errors.
See docs for details.

expect.text:
Build started...
Compiling module A
Compiling module B
Build finished with errors.
See docs for details.

why: Marks let you bookmark positions without losing your place. Setting mark 'a' at the top and 'e' at the error lets you jump freely between them with backtick or single-quote motions.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use m{letter} to set a mark, '{letter} to jump to its line, and `{letter} to jump to its exact column.
